evidence.documentation: PR author marks documentation as not affected. The change improves in-CLI error messages and existing `--backend` behavior; no new flags, config keys, or documented behavior change. No documentation update required.
evidence.manual_release_testing: Evidence of manual testing exists: the author shows concrete `build/lemonade bench` output for both the no-backend-found error case and the `--backend vulkan` auto-install success case (including download progress). @jeremyfowers additionally confirms independent local testing. No additional manual to-do required.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added to the PR branch after the latest approval (@jeremyfowers, 2026-09-30T14:59:43Z). The diff was stable. The post-approval commits returned by the merge-group queue (PRs #3692, #3559, #3684, #3695) belong to other PRs in the same merge group, not to this PR.
evidence.review: PR #3690 received two approvals. @iswaryaalex raised two substantive inline comments: (1) suggest mentioning the `--backend` flag when no backends are found — the author addressed this by adding 'Or rerun the lemonade bench command with the --backend <name> flag to automatically install the backend(s).' to the error output; (2) suggest a `--yes/-y` confirmation prompt before auto-installing — the author rejected this on the basis of consistency with other lemonade commands (load/pull install without asking) and the explicit intent conveyed by passing `--backend`. @iswaryaalex then approved. @jeremyfowers approved with 'Tested locally, works great!'. Subject-matter expertise present: @bitgamma maintains CLI/backends/benchmarking; @jeremyfowers is an admin maintainer with expertise in new CLI commands.

evidence.tests: No new automated tests were added for the new `install_requested_backends` helper or the improved error messages. subject: Auto-install specified backends with `lemonade bench` (#3690)
summary: Auto-install specified backends when `lemonade bench` is run with `--backend <name>` and provide actionable error messages with auto-install suggestions when no installed backend is found and none is specified.
verdict_reason: Well-scoped CLI enhancement with substantive expert review from two reviewers, inline feedback addressed, and evidence of manual testing by both the author and an independent reviewer.
